text:
Maya Chen: FYI — invoice INV-2026-231 for Zephyrix (acct ZP-823) posted with two promo credits stacked (Q2-dedicated-trial + onboarding-waiver). UI shows total credits = -$3,200 but the credits hit the same usage row, looks duplicated. Can we do a manual adjustment/rollback? https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-231 :eyes:

Liam O'Connell: I pulled the invoice. I see two line items: 
- PROMO-TRIAL-DEDICATED: -$2,000
- PROMO-ONBOARD-WAIVER: -$1,200
They should be on different buckets (reserved vs usage) — if they both applied to usage that's wrong.

Jia Patel: tagging accounting — do we need a credit memo or a negative invoice? We normally issue a credit memo and then a journal entry for reconciliation.

Arun Singh: @Nora Alvarez can you sign off on a manual credit? Zephyrix is an active pilot customer;collector flagged this as potential double apply.

Nora Alvarez: on it. Quick check — if both promos were meant for distinct charges, we should move one to a reserved-capacity waiver instead of refunding. But if they truly duplicated, we credit back. What's the requested amount?

Maya Chen: Requested manual adjustment = +$1,200 (i.e., remove duplicate onboarding-waiver from usage). We prefer adjusting the invoice instead of issuing refund to avoid cash flow churn.

Liam O'Connell: Proposed journal adjustment (will attach to credit memo):
```
Date: 2026-05-01
Debit: Promo Expense (GL 7205)   $1,200
Credit: Accounts Receivable     $1,200
Memo: Remove duplicated onboarding-waiver promo applied to INV-2026-231 (ZP-823)
```

Jia Patel: Accounting ok with that journal. Please add internal note with approver name and attach Azure S3 export of invoice.

Nora Alvarez: Approved. @Liam O'Connell please create credit memo CM-2026-089 and update the invoice, add note "approved by Nora Alvarez 2026-05-01". No cash refund — apply as adjustment.

Liam O'Connell: Will do. Creating CM-2026-089 now and routing to invoices-bot for recording.

invoices-bot: CM-2026-089 created and linked to INV-2026-231. Journal reference JNL-98742 recorded.

Arun Singh: Thx team. Maya — can you confirm Zephyrix support ticket gets an explanatory message so they don't escalate to CSM?

Maya Chen: Yes, I'll update the ticket and ping CSM. Quick note for FYI: let's add a small validation in billing flow to disallow two promo IDs from applying to the same usage row — logging a small engineering request (eng-billing) after the adjustment.

Liam O'Connell: Filing a bug with billing ops: TICKET-BILL-451. I'll include reproduction steps and invoice sample.

Maya Chen: Closing loop — adjustment applied, CM-2026-089 attached, customer notified. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
